fields.Name: IT109 - Agent Run Audience
fields.Description: An agent run bounded by an audience (ExecuteAgentParams.Audience), deterministic, no LLM: pre-execution RAG runs directly and actions go through BaseAgent.ExecuteSingleAction for the seeded IT: Search Agent. Setup grants the seeded no-grant user Search on 'IT: Integration Test Scope' by UserID (deleted in Teardown); the bundle seeds no notes (a note save embeds), so the proof is the search and action logs. AU1: the caller alone searches the scope (a Success row). AU2: with an audience of the no-grant user nothing is injected and the search logs ResultCount 0. AU3: a reader with no grant on the scope (RLS user A) gets one Forbidden row naming them and no search. AU4: Scoped Search with an audience returns no results and no SourceCounts. AU5: an action without audience support is refused (AUDIENCE_UNSUPPORTED), writes no execution log row and is locked out. AU6: Execute with an unknown reader ID fails before any prompt. AU7: the run's scope binds the Scoped Search tenant: dispatched on a run whose PrimaryScopeRecordID is A, a model-supplied tenant B is refused (INVALID_PARAM, one Forbidden row, no search), and with no model tenant the search runs under A (a Success row recording A).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A run's audience bounds pre-execution retrieval (every reader passes the scope gate; results are what every reader may read), the search actions (no SourceCounts for a room), and every other action (refused, never run); an unknown reader fails the run before any prompt.
